_readme: Variante del CV para la oferta Senior Node.js Engineer de Commit Offshore (djinni 850194). Se fusiona sobre content.json: los objetos se combinan, las listas se sustituyen.

hero.tagline: Senior Node.js engineer · TypeScript · MongoDB · Redis · REST APIs · CI/CD

flowpack.description: Multi-tenant logistics SaaS (deliveries and pickups) for carriers and agencies. Sole architect and developer: system design, Node.js/TypeScript REST API, frontend and CI/CD with staging and production environments.

pagine.description: Exchange marketplace for the Italian community with the VAL complementary currency. Node.js API and React frontend on MongoDB; full architecture and development for the client.

foodchain.description: Agri-food traceability startup with its own blockchain (Quadrans). Backend services and the web app that read from the chain. Three concrete contributions:

chocosfera.problem: Ethical cocoa traceability on blockchain: a Telegram bot lets growers photograph the tree, capture geolocation and issue a tokenized digital certificate; the same channel connects producer and buyer.
chocosfera.metric: Real field data from cocoa growers in Venezuela

facts.v: Building for the web since 2013, self-taught; Web3 from the start.
Solopreneur: architect and developer at once. I know what every technical decision costs in euros and in hours of sleep.
Async and documented by habit, not by mandate. Comfortable in fully remote teams.
